sources.summary: Swedish brand IKEA has unveiled its Kompishäng collection for short-term renters, featuring a £7 wardrobe organiser that doubles as a backpack and a side table that can be carried over the arm like a handbag. Kompishäng is a 12-piece range of "affordable and portable" furniture and homeware, none of which costs more than £70.
